# english

![Logo](data:image/png;base64,)

Enhancing the landscape in Heroes3. New, separate backgrounds for underground.

## Porting details

Currently ported version: 0.0.4

### Not supported yet

Original image usage can found [here](https://github.com/Paracelsus83/H3Landscape/blob/main/Landscape/game_mod/battlefield.cpp).

- CmBkMCDk.png (boat in magic clouds)
- CmBkCstUg.png (costal background is currently hardcoded in VCMI)
- CmBkLkUg.png (costal background for underground also not supported)
